tier_reason: The third-party stephenberry/json_performance README ('Latest results (June 8, 2025)') lists json_struct at 5.87 s roundtrip, 178 MB/s write, 316 MB/s read against nlohmann at 15.44 s, 86 MB/s, 81 MB/s, with public harness code in src/main.cpp (nlohmann v3.11.3 pinned in CMakeLists.txt) on a MacBook Pro M1 with Clang 17. Optimization flags and build type are stated nowhere (CMakeLists.txt sets no CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE), so it falls short of A; the measurement is independent of both json_struct and nlohmann, hence B.

corrections.compiler_and_flags: Clang 17 per the README (Apple vs LLVM build not stated); no optimization flags or build type stated. CMakeLists.txt sets CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23 (plus target_compile_features cxx_std_20) and -Wall -Wextra only, with no default CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE; src/main.cpp uses 1,000,000 iterations only under NDEBUG, so the published run was a release-type build. json_struct is fetched from its master branch, nlohmann from release v3.11.3.
corrections.caveats: Comparison is struct binding, not DOM parsing (nlohmann goes through its DOM via json::parse plus get<obj_t>, which is how that library binds structs), and the harness author is the Glaze maintainer (a competitor, but not of json_struct or nlohmann); the harness repo itself has about 30 stars. Optimization flags and build type are not stated and the Clang build (Apple or LLVM) is unspecified; hence tier B, not A. Results are dated June 8, 2025 and json_struct was pulled from master at build time, so the version measured is unknown. On the same harness json_struct trails Glaze, yyjson, reflect-cpp, daw_json_link and RapidJSON, and its roundtrip (5.87 s) is slower than Boost.JSON (5.38 s); the win is only against nlohmann. MB/s figures are scaled by the minified document length. json_struct's own repo has a performance/ folder (json_struct vs RapidJSON, simdjson and nlohmann under Catch2) but publishes no results, and the README makes no performance claim, so the list's 'High performance' wording is not backed by the project itself. COPYING is an HPND-sell-variant permissive licence (GitHub shows no SPDX id; the awesome-cpp tag says MIT); it is a variant of the OSI-approved HPND, though SPDX does not flag the sell variant itself as OSI-approved; no patent grant.

notes: Numbers match the json_performance README row for row and the derived ratios (2.6x roundtrip, 2.1x write, 3.9x read vs nlohmann v3.11.3) are correct; harness code is fair (same object, validity check via is_valid_write). Shortcomings: flags/build type unstated, harness run by the Glaze author in June 2025 on an unpinned json_struct master, json_struct is mid-pack (slower than five other libraries and than Boost.JSON on roundtrip), no first-party performance numbers. Metadata checked: 474 stars, not archived, not a fork, last commit 2026-08-29 (commits atom feed), active.
